name: xpcog
description: Cross-platform wxWidgets port of the Cog audio player

gui.description: wxWidgets: the application's UI toolkit on Windows and macOS, neither of which packages it. A feature rather than a plain dependency for two reasons. The headless presets build no app and should not drag a toolkit into a target that links none -- and the Linux presets leave it off as well, because this port depends on vcpkg's gtk3 port: requesting it there builds 57 packages from source -- wx, GTK, glib, pango, cairo, harfbuzz, fontconfig, at-spi2, dbus and seven X11 libraries -- on a machine that already has every one of them. Linux takes wx from the distribution instead (libwxgtk3.2-dev); see cmake/XPCogWx.cmake
